assumptions: Lossless mirrors of power reflectance R, joined by an engine loop (ringDown); the paper's silver absorbs, so its I0 is below the incident intensity. Not modelled.
Each spectral line is strictly monochromatic and the lines are mutually incoherent: one cw run per line, intensities added.
Normal incidence (Delta = 2 e), one plate spacing; fringes in convergent light (rings), white-light superposition fringes and standard films are not simulated.
